commentary.text: 90+13' Juan Pulido is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+12' What a great touch by Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
90+11' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Juanpe (Girona) replacing Arnau Martinez.
90+11' Today's match ends for Yaser Asprilla who will be replaced by Alejandro Frances (Girona).
90+9' 2 - 1 Goal! Alex Padilla gets a hand on the penalty from Cristhian Stuani (Girona), but can't stop it from flying inside the right post.
90+8' This was really stupid from Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao)! He is booked for the second time today and is forced to leave the pitch after seeing a red card in the hand of Juan Pulido.
90+7' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+7' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
90+7' It’s a PENALTY to Girona after the VAR review!

90+7' Play continues despite the shouts by some Girona players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Juan Pulido interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
90+5' PENALTY APPEAL by Girona, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
90+5' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Gabriel Misehouy (Girona). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

90+5' What a save from Alex Padilla! Cristhian Stuani (Girona) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out. Girona win a corner.
90+4' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) takes a long run up and launches the free kick towards goal from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall bravely blocks the effort.
90+3' Michel has decided to substitute Abel Ruiz and he is replaced by Cristhian Stuani (Girona).
90+3' Substitution. Gabriel Misehouy (Girona) in, Ivan Martin out.
90+3' A player from Girona takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Ath Bilbao win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
90+1' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Yangel Herrera (Girona) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
90' Juan Pulido blows his whistle and it's Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
89' That's a well-taken pass by Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
88' Donny van de Beek pings in a cross towards the edge of the six-yard box. Ladislav Krejci (Girona) jumps highest but sends his header just over the bar.

86' Yangel Herrera (Girona) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Alex Padilla shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
86' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
81' Yangel Herrera (Girona) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.
81' Close! Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) picks up a pass and produces a ferocious strike towards the right post, but the goalkeeper gets his fingertips to the ball to keep it out.
79' Here is a change. Adama Boiro is going off and Ernesto Valverde Tejedor gives the last tactical orders to Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao).
79' That will be all from Ander Herrera who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao).
78' The foul by Bryan Gil (Girona) was seen by Juan Pulido who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
78' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) will take a corner kick.
76' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

76' Donny van de Beek (Girona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Girona will have a chance to score from a corner.
75' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
74' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
73' A rebound falls at the feet of Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao), whose promising strike from long range flies a few inches wide of the right post! What a great effort!
72' Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) makes a strong challenge and Juan Pulido blows for a foul.
69' The referee blows for a cooling break.
67' Bryan Gil (Girona) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

67' Arnau Martinez (Girona) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Girona force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
65' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
64' Yangel Herrera (Girona) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
59' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor decides to make a substitution. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta will be replaced by Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao).
59' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to make a change. Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) replaces Gorka Guruzeta.
59' The referee signals a substitution. Bryan Gil (Girona) is brought on as a substitute for Arnaut Danjuma.
58' Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) fails to score from the penalty spot. His effort towards the bottom left corner lacks any pace and that allows the goalkeeper to make a stunning save.
57' Wait! The referee has seen an infringement and Ath Bilbao will have to take the penalty again!
57' David Lopez (Girona) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.

56' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it low towards the middle of the target. His effort isn't powerful nor precise enough, allowing Paulo Gazzaniga to keep the ball out of the net.
56' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is going to take the penalty!
56' Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
55' The Ath Bilbao players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
54' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Ath Bilbao! Let's see what he decides.
53' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) is furious with himself as he misses a clear opportunity from the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
53' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
51' Yangel Herrera (Girona) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
50' Arnau Martinez (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
48' Yangel Herrera (Girona) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
47' Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' Juan Pulido has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+6' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) decides to keep the ball to himself and weaves through the defence into the box. From there he takes a shot which goes narrowly wide of the target.
45+5' The corner kick from Yaser Asprilla (Girona) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
45+5' Donny van de Beek (Girona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Girona.
45+4' Ladislav Krejci (Girona) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
45+3' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Juan Pulido blows his whistle after Yangel Herrera (Girona) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
43' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor is forced to make a change. Oihan Sancet is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao).
43' The injury to Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.

41' 1 - 1 Goal! Alex Berenguer shows great vision to find Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the right side of the goal. 1:1.
39' 1 - 0 Yaser Asprilla (Girona) receives a brilliant pass and hammers the ball inside the left post. It couldn't have gone in a better place. What a beautiful long-range goal.
37' Yangel Herrera (Girona) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar.
37' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

36' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Alex Padilla shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
35' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) latches onto a long ball into the box and unleashes a fine volley at goal, but flashes the effort just wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal!
34' Total attempts – 3:4. The number of shots on goal at present is 0:3.
34' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
31' This is a yellow card! Ladislav Krejci (Girona) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
31' Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the left side of the goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga is alert and makes a decent save.
30' Girona are ruled offside.
29' Donny van de Beek (Girona) strikes a promising volley towards goal, but one of the defenders is quick enough to step in and make a crucial block.
28' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) doesn't take advantage of the chance to score from the penalty spot. He shoots to the bottom right corner, but Paulo Gazzaniga leaps out to thwart his effort.
28' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
27' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Ath Bilbao!

27' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Ath Bilbao.
26' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
25' Ivan Martin (Girona) is penalised for holding. Juan Pulido signals a set piece.

24' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) produces an attempt from the edge of the box which would have most likely endangered the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players blocked it, so we can only speculate about the outcome.
24' Abel Ruiz loses the ball after receiving a sweet pass from Arnaut Danjuma (Girona).
21' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
21' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Juan Pulido blows his whistle for a foul. Girona are awarded a free kick.
19' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the right post.
17' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
16' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) picks up a short pass and immediately fires a shot towards the bottom left corner from distance, but Paulo Gazzaniga hardly has to move and makes a very easy save.
15' Adama Boiro (Ath Bilbao) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
14' David Lopez (Girona) sends a long ball in, but Alex Padilla comfortably gathers the ball.
13' Juan Pulido interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao).
12' Ivan Martin (Girona) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Ath Bilbao will have a goal kick.
9' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is able to continue to play. Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) is moving okay again after that injury scare.

8' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment. Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
7' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) plays a long ball to Arnaut Danjuma, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.

6' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Arnaut Danjuma, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
5' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
4' A long pass, executed by Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
2' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) sends a long ball in, but Alex Padilla comfortably gathers the ball.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Girona will have the kick-off.
Juan Pulido was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
